description: This file implements an OpenAI embedder class with batching, rate limiting, and configuration validation, utilizing the OpenAI API and handling errors with telemetry and retries.

classes.name: OpenAiEmbedder
classes.description: A class that provides embedding functionalities using OpenAI API with batching, retries, and validation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the embedder with API options and sets up the OpenAI client.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates embeddings for a list of texts, handling batching and token limits.

methods.name: _embedBatchWithRetries
methods.description: Handles batch embedding with retries and exponential backoff on rate limit errors.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by performing a test embedding request.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the embedder, such as its name.
